data.name: RootCommandDescription
data.value: C# XML Documentation and Reflection Exporter into MkDocs Markdown

data.name: AssemblyOptionDescription
data.value: Path to the compiled target assembly file (.dll)

data.name: XmlOptionDescription
data.value: Path to the compiler-generated XML documentation file (.xml)

data.name: OutputOptionDescription
data.value: Path to the output directory for generated Markdown files

data.name: ExamplesOptionDescription
data.value: Optional directory containing external code example snippets

data.name: OverridesOptionDescription
data.value: Optional directory containing supplementary markdown sidecar override files

data.name: MsDocsOptionDescription
data.value: Base URL for Microsoft Learn API documentation links

data.name: LogLevelOptionDescription
data.value: Console logging minimum level (Trace, Debug, Information, Warning, Error, Critical, None)

data.name: AssemblyCommandDescription
data.value: Export documentation for one or more compiled assemblies (.dll)

data.name: SolutionCommandDescription
data.value: Export unified documentation for all projects in a C# solution (.sln or .slnx)

data.name: SolutionOptionDescription
data.value: Path to the C# solution file (.sln or .slnx)

data.name: ConfigurationOptionDescription
data.value: Build configuration used to locate compiled project outputs (Debug or Release)

data.name: IncludeTestsOptionDescription
data.value: Include test projects when exporting a solution

data.name: ExternalDocsOptionDescription
data.value: Custom third-party documentation link mappings in NamespacePrefix=UrlTemplate format

data.name: ConfigCommandDescription
data.value: Export documentation using a declarative JSON configuration file

data.name: ConfigOptionDescription
data.value: Path to the JSON configuration file (doc-exporter.json)

data.name: NavFileOptionDescription
data.value: Optional path to an existing or target MkDocs YAML file (mkdocs.yml or mkdocs.nav.yml) to generate or extend

data.name: NavEntryPointOptionDescription
data.value: Optional navigation entry point section path (e.g. 'API Reference' or 'Developer Guide/API Reference') or comment placeholder where generated navigation should be inserted

data.name: NavUrlPrefixOptionDescription
data.value: Optional relative URL prefix prepended to generated Markdown links in the MkDocs navigation (e.g. 'api')

data.name: ExcludeOptionDescription
data.value: Optional project or assembly names and wildcard patterns (e.g. '*.Tests', '*.Benchmarks') to exclude when exporting

data.name: DiagramFormatOptionDescription
data.value: Preferred diagram generator format for type and index pages (for example Mermaid, PlantUml, None, or any custom plugin format; defaults to Mermaid and falls back to another registered generator when a diagram type is unsupported)

data.name: CleanOptionDescription
data.value: Clean existing Markdown (.md) and PlantUML (.puml) files in the output directory prior to export

data.name: FailOnMissingOptionDescription
data.value: Fail export execution if any included project artifact (.dll or .xml) in the solution is missing

data.name: FailOnUndocumentedOptionDescription
data.value: Minimum required documentation coverage percentage (0.0 to 100.0). Export fails if coverage is below this threshold

data.name: StrictOptionDescription
data.value: Enable strict relative link validation; fails export if any relative Markdown link cannot be resolved

data.name: ExcludeTypesOptionDescription
data.value: Optional type names or wildcard patterns (e.g. '*Internal*') to exclude from generated documentation

data.name: ExcludeNamespacesOptionDescription
data.value: Optional namespace names or wildcard patterns (e.g. '*.Migrations') to exclude from generated documentation

data.name: ExcludeEditorBrowsableNeverOptionDescription
data.value: Automatically excludes types and members decorated with [EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)].

data.name: InvalidExternalDocRuleFormat
data.value: Invalid external documentation link rule format: '{0}'. Expected format: '<NamespacePattern>=<UrlTemplate>' (for example, 'Serilog*=https://serilog.net/api/{{type}}').

data.name: InvalidFailOnUndocumentedPercentage
data.value: Cannot parse argument '{0}' for option '--fail-on-undocumented' as a valid percentage number.

data.name: ConfigFileNotFound
data.value: Configuration file not found: '{0}'.

data.name: ConfigFileLoadFailed
data.value: Failed to load configuration file '{0}': {1}

data.name: ReportFileOptionDescription
data.value: Optional output file path for the structured documentation quality and diagnostics report.

data.name: ReportFormatOptionDescription
data.value: Output format for the documentation quality report: Json (default), Markdown, Sarif, or a custom plugin format name.

data.name: NavFormatOptionDescription
data.value: Target static-site navigation generator format (MkDocs by default, None to disable, or any custom plugin format name).

data.name: PluginsDirOptionDescription
data.value: Optional directory path containing external plugin assemblies (.dll) implementing IDocumentationExporterPlugin.
